trimmingSuggestions.description: Drastically reduce the speed of the baby prediction image slideshow. This would make it less overwhelming and allow viewers to actually see the images.
Tighten the editing to focus on the most relevant points of the psychic twins' predictions. The jump between baby predictions and Princess Diana's personal life is abrupt and could be smoother.
